description: Read live sports betting odds from around 95 bookmakers, exchanges and daily-fantasy sites across nine regions. List the leagues and their fixtures, price a whole league or a single game in any market from moneylines to player props, find which bookmaker is paying the most on each outcome, and follow live scores and final results. Every action reports what it cost and how many usage credits are left, and every action works on the free plan.
